Settings.note: Siga ahantu ubusa kugeza icyemezo gifashwe: nta mafaranga yakwa kandi nta kintu gisezeranywa ku hasigaye ubusa. Buri mpinduka yandikwa mu nyandiko z'ibikorwa, kandi ibyabitswe bigumana igenamiterere ryariho.
Settings.moneyHint: Umushyitsi yishyura igiciro n'amafaranga ya serivisi. Nyir'inzu ahabwa igiciro gikuweho komisiyo.
Settings.cancellationHint: Agaragazwa abashyitsi mbere yo kubika kandi akabikwa na buri gikorwa. Yandike muri buri rurimi.
Settings.upfrontMonths: Amezi yishyurwa ubika (ubusa = amezi yose yahiswemo)
Settings.monthlyHint: Umushyitsi ahitamo amezi ashaka gukodesha. Usize ubusa, yishyura amezi yose abika; shyiraho umubare kugira ngo yishyure ayo mezi gusa mbere. Lodge n'ibyumba byishyurwa ku ijoro buri gihe.
Settings.referralHint: Igihembo gishyirwaho nyuma y'uko inshuti yatumiwe irangiza bwa mbere, kandi itsinda ryemeza buri kimwe. Siga ubusa niba nta gihembo.
Settings.identityHint: Saba gusa ibyo ikigo n'amategeko bisaba. Itsinda ryonyine ni ryo ribona aya makuru.
Settings.dislikeHint: Siga ubusa kugira ngo inzu zitazigera zihishwa ku buryo bwikora. Abakozi bashobora gutuma inzu ihora igaragara no kongera kugaragaza izahishwe.
Settings.promoterHint: Amafaranga adahinduka akoreshwa iyo yashyizweho. Ibihembo biza nyuma y'icumbi ryishyuwe ryarangiye kandi bitegereza kwemezwa n'abakozi.
Settings.feeModelHint: Abakiriya bahora babona igiteranyo kimwe: amafaranga y'urubuga ntagaragara ukwayo. Buri fatwa ribika ibipimo byakoreshejwe.
Settings.commissionByTypeHint: Siga icyiciro ubusa kugira ngo hakoreshwe komisiyo isanzwe.
Settings.taxHint: Bikoreshwa gusa mu kugereranya imisoro muri Raporo. Emeza uko imisoro ibarwa mbere yo kubyizera.
Settings.paymentHint: Bigaragara ku mafatwa atishyuwe igihe nta buryo bwo kwishyura buhujwe. Nyir'inzu cyangwa abakozi bemeza buri kwishyura.

teamError.notAllowed: Nyirayo wenyine ni we uhindura itsinda.
teamError.noAccount: Nta konti ikoresha iyi meyili. Musabe kubanza kwiyandikisha.

Food.adminIntro: Resitora, urutonde rw'ibiryo n'ibitumijwe. Zishyire ku rubuga ziteguye; uzihishe utanze impamvu bibaye ngombwa.
Food.adminNewIntro: Kora resitora ya nyirayo, cyangwa icungwa na VIIPA.
Food.publishFailed: Ntibyakunze. Resitora ikenera nibura ibiryo kimwe mbere yo kujya ku rubuga.
Food.homeBannerSub: Resitora zikugezaho ibiryo aho uri cyangwa mu cyumba cyawe.
Food.ownersOnly: Resitora zishyirwaho na ba nyir'inzu n'itsinda rya VIIPA. Ushobora gutumiza muri resitora iyo ari yo yose iri ku rubuga.
Food.noMatch: Nta kiri ku rutonde gihuye na «{query}».
Food.addMore: Ongeraho {amount} kugira ngo ugere ku byo bemera nibura.

Promoters.title: Kwamamaza no kwinjiza
Promoters.intro: Sangiza QR code yawe. Abashyitsi uzanye nibarangiza icumbi ryishyuwe, uhabwa igihembo.
Promoters.introReward: Sangiza QR code yawe. Abashyitsi uzanye nibarangiza icumbi ryishyuwe, uhabwa {reward} kuri buri cumbi.
Promoters.aboutHint: urugero ikigo cyanjye cy'ubukerarugendo i Musanze, urupapuro rwanjye rwa Instagram
Promoters.applied: Murakoze! Itsinda ryacu rizagenzura ubusabe bwanyu.
Promoters.pendingNote: Ubusabe bwawe burimo kugenzurwa. QR code yawe izagaragara hano numara kwemerwa.
Promoters.codeHint: Yicapishe cyangwa usangize ihuza. Gusura bibarwa rimwe ku munsi kuri buri muntu; ibihembo bikurikira amacumbi yishyuwe yarangiye.
Promoters.rules: Ibihembo bigenzurwa n'itsinda ryacu. Amacumbi yawe bwite, amafatwa yahagaritswe cyangwa atishyuwe, n'umushyitsi umwe kabiri mu minsi 30 ntibibarwa.
Promoters.adminIntro: Emeza cyangwa uhagarike abamamaza, wemeze kandi wishyure ibihembo byabo. Amafaranga y'ibihembo ashyirwaho muri Igenamiterere.

Reports.intro: Amafaranga n'ibikorwa bikurikije itariki y'icumbi. Amacumbi yishyuwe n'abataje arabarwa; ayahagaritswe abarwa gusa ku mafaranga yasubijwe. Ingwate zirabikwa, si inyungu.
Reports.taxNote: Ni igereranya gusa, ku bipimo byashyizwe muri Igenamiterere. Emeza uko imisoro ibarwa n'umucungamari wawe mbere yo kumenyekanisha.

ManualPay.noInstructions: Itsinda ryacu rizakubwira uko wishyura. Koresha Ubufasha niba ufite ikibazo.
ManualPay.useReference: Andika {reference} mu butumwa bwo kwishyura niba bishoboka.
ManualPay.transactionHint: Iri mu butumwa bugufi bwa mobile money
ManualPay.waiting: Murakoze! Kwishyura {reference} biri kugenzurwa na nyir'inzu cyangwa itsinda ryacu. Iminsi yawe ikomeza kubikwa.
ManualPay.checkFirst: Emeza gusa umaze kubona amafaranga kuri konti yawe ya mobile money cyangwa ya banki.

confirmError.notAllowed: Nyir'inzu cyangwa abakozi ba VIIPA bonyine ni bo bemeza kwishyura.
confirmError.datesTaken: Iminsi yafashwe igihe cyo kubika kirangiye; itsinda ryacu ryamenyeshejwe gusubiza amafaranga.
